messages.bodyText:
Hey!

Are we still on for Saturday? I found a great spot in Osu that just opened last week — they do wood-fired plantain flatbreads and hibiscus spritzes.

Let me know if 7:30 PM works for you and Kwame. I can grab us a table on the terrace before it fills up.

Best,
Ama
